name: Disneyland Troubadour Tavern (Fantasyland) Classic Butter, Cheddar & Bacon Baked Russet Potato
whyItWorks: Troubadour Tavern is Disneyland's dedicated baked-potato stand! A hot foil-baked Idaho Russet potato with butter, aged cheddar, and bacon bits (or pulled pork/chicken when featured) is an inexpensive, gluten-free, soluble-fiber gem.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Baked Potato with butter, cheddar, and bacon—ask to hold the sour cream and raw green onions, and scoop out the soft potato interior while leaving the skin.
watchOuts: Leave the fibrous outer potato skin behind and ask for no raw green onions or spicy sauces
